headline: Up to ₹1500 off domestic hotels
description: Flat instant discount on domestic hotel bookings by booking value: 500 rupees off on 2000–3000, 750 off on 3000–4000, 1000 off on 4000–6000, 1500 off on 6000 and above. Valid on website, mobile site and the Android/iOS apps.
how_to_redeem:
1. Search and select a domestic hotel on Goibibo.
2. Apply code MEGASALE at checkout.
3. Discount is applied by booking value.
terms: Domestic hotels only; min booking 2000 rupees; Goibibo T&Cs apply.

headline: 1 night free on 12-night domestic hotel stays
description: Get 1 night free when you book 12 nights at select domestic hotels on Goibibo.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book a 12-night stay at a participating domestic hotel on Goibibo.
2. Apply code FREESTAY at checkout.
terms: Select domestic hotels only; Goibibo T&Cs apply.

headline: New-user discount on first domestic hotel booking
description: Discount on your first domestic hotel booking on Goibibo, calculated on the property's base (pre-tax) price. Valid on select hotels, hostels, villas and apartments.
how_to_redeem:
1. Sign up / log in to Goibibo as a new user.
2. Select a domestic hotel and apply code GOIBIBO at checkout.
terms: First hotel booking only; select properties; cannot be combined with other offers; goCash not usable with this offer.

headline: Buy 1 Get 3 Free: Breadstix + Fries + Pepsi free with a pizza (no code)
description: Order a Medium Pan or Thin 'n Crispy pizza and get Classic Breadstix, Cheezy Sprinkled Fries and a Pepsi free. No code needed.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open pizzahut.co.in or the Pizza Hut app.
2. Choose the Buy 1 Get 3 Free deal and pick your Medium / Thin 'n Crispy pizza.
3. The free items are added automatically.
terms: Menu and availability vary by outlet; Pizza Hut T&Cs apply.
verified_note: ✓ Official Pizza Hut deal page (checked 3 Oct 2026)

headline: Extra ₹100 off selected festive products (no code)
description: Extra 100 rupees off on selected boAt products in the festive collection. Applied automatically on marked products.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the boAt festive collection on boat-lifestyle.com.
2. Add products marked with the extra 100 off badge.
3. Discount applies automatically at checkout.
terms: Selected products only; boAt T&Cs apply.
verified_note: ✓ Official boAt festive collection page (checked 3 Oct 2026)
